confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors come from secondary web sources with mixed dates, converted at roughly 1 EUR = 1.12 USD. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season, not checked against live listings. The FX observation is the latest RBA figure I could retrieve (20 March 2026), not a confirmed current rate, so it may be stale.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink are based on Benidorm-specific reviews and listings plus Spain-wide cost-of-living figures. Accommodation is benchmarked against Spanish Mediterranean coastal resort towns with strong summer tourism demand.
